verdict.rationale: Ultrametric ships a documented official CLI on npm (ultrametric@0.4.1) with agent-oriented features: `--json` structured stdout/stderr output, non-interactive device-code login, `doctor`, and `init` to install skills for Codex and Claude Code. Recorded hands-on runs confirm the version, help-listed commands, dry-run init, offline guide commands and schema validation all work. Missing for 10: no recorded authenticated session showing the hosted process/context commands succeeding end to end (keyless runs only reached the AUTH_REQUIRED wall).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use `--json` when an agent runs the CLI. Successful results appear on stdout as a `schemaVersion` and `data` object.
The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.
With `--json`, the agent gets the link and controls completion without an interactive prompt.
